name: Circular Radial-Fill & Magnetic Outline CTA

js_hover_behavior: mouseenter/mouseout repositions inner 20px circle span to cursor coords and expands to 350px; .btn_wrapper mousemove pulls button +/-80px via gsap.to(0.5s, power2.out)
a11y_notes: Preserve native <a>/<button> focus ring (#3BC77B); disable 80px magnetic offset on coarse pointers & reduced-motion.

name: Secondary / Variant Circular Magnetic CTAs
js_hover_behavior: Shares .btn-hover cursor-origin radial circle + .btn_wrapper GSAP magnetic pull.
a11y_notes: Avoid un-highlighted #999999 resting text on dark backgrounds; enforce >= 4.5:1 text contrast.

name: Header Emerald-Outlined Pill CTA

a11y_notes: Min height >= 50px satisfies WCAG touch size; ensure clear focus outline on dark translucent headers.

name: Dark Rounded Action Pill

name: MixItUp Category Filter Pill

name: Oversized Video Lightbox Trigger Circle
